result.rationale: Low-energy ankle inversion in a 29-year-old with mild pain, small swelling, no deformity/numbness/wound, and no malleolar or midfoot bony tenderness. Weight-bearing is untested rather than failed, so the Ottawa weight-bearing criterion is unknown, not positive. Home care (protection, rest, ice, compression, elevation, gradual movement) with instruction to attempt a few steps and seek assessment if unable to bear weight, or if pain/swelling worsen or fail to improve.
